weights.csoNote: Ugandan basePrior is rising with epidemiological transition (historically lower than Western data) — confirm local frequency; also 'family history premature cardiac death' is NOT in the standard capture token set (capture gap to add).
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2023 ACS Guidelines (Byrne RA et al., Eur Heart J 2023;44:3720-3826); 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline (Gulati M et al., 2021)

weights.csoNote: Two strong discriminators are NOT in the HPC feature/risk token set: 'unequal pulses' (an examination sign, captured at CVS exam not HPC) and 'Marfan / connective tissue disease' (risk-token gap) — both should be added to capture so they can move the rank.
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2014 Aortic Diseases Guidelines (Erbel R et al., Eur Heart J 2014;35:2873-2926); 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline; Macleod's Clinical Examination 15th ed (2023)

weights.csoNote: PE is under-diagnosed in Uganda (limited CTPA/D-dimer access) — true frequency likely higher than detected; basePrior reflects detection, not incidence. Confirm with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2019 Acute Pulmonary Embolism Guidelines (Konstantinides SV et al., Eur Heart J 2020;41:543-603)

weights.csoNote: Oesophageal pain can mimic ACS and even respond to GTN — never use relief-with-GTN to exclude ACS.
weights.weightCitation: 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline (Gulati M et al., 2021); Davidson's 24th ed (GI)

weights.csoNote: Key stable-angina-vs-ACS discriminators (relief within minutes of rest/GTN; stability/predictability over weeks) are NOT fully in the capture token set (tempo/relief). Add capture for 'relieved by rest' and symptom stability so the engine can separate stable angina from ACS.
weights.weightCitation: ESC 2019 Chronic Coronary Syndromes Guidelines (Knuuti J et al., Eur Heart J 2020;41:407-477); 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline

weights.csoNote: Uganda: HIV-associated pneumonia (incl. PCP) common; TB can mimic/coexist.
weights.weightCitation: Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 (pneumonia); WHO; Davidson's 24th ed; BTS CAP guideline

weights.csoNote: basePrior far exceeds Western data — TB is the leading cause of exudative pleural effusion in high-burden Uganda; exact frequency among chest-pain presentations is an extrapolation. Confirm local weighting with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: WHO Operational Handbook on TB (2022); Uganda National TB & Leprosy Programme guidelines; Davidson's 24th ed (TB pleural effusion)

weights.csoNote: DIAGNOSIS OF EXCLUSION — must not anchor here before excluding ACS, PE, arrhythmia and thyrotoxicosis. Recommend the engine never ranks this above an unexcluded must-not-miss. Confirm safeguard with CSO.
weights.weightCitation: 2021 AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline (noncardiac causes); DSM-5-TR (panic disorder); Davidson's 24th ed

weights.csoNote: Uganda: dermatomal pain PRECEDES the rash by days (mimics cardiac/pleuritic pain); zoster in a young adult should prompt HIV testing (WHO clinical stage 2).
weights.weightCitation: Davidson's 24th ed; Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 (herpes zoster/HIV); WHO HIV clinical staging

weights.csoNote: The must-not-miss pin should ideally be CONDITIONAL on sickle-cell-disease status (a 'don't forget' only in SCD patients); basePrior is population-dependent (high SCD prevalence in Uganda). Confirm conditional-pin behaviour with CSO. EMERGENCY in a known SCD patient: chest pain + fever + new infiltrate + hypoxia.
weights.weightCitation: ASH acute chest syndrome definition (Blood 2025); Nansseu JRN et al., BMC Pediatr 2015 (ACS in SSA); Davidson's 24th ed (haematology)

weights.csoNote: Epigastric pain overlaps INFERIOR MI — do not dismiss as GI without an ECG.
weights.weightCitation: Davidson's Principles & Practice of Medicine 24th ed (2022) (GI); Macleod's Clinical Examination 15th ed (2023)

weights.csoNote: Chest pain is a less typical PRIMARY presentation (exertional dyspnoea dominates). Ugandan causes differ — schistosomiasis-associated PAH and post-TB lung disease are important; schistosomiasis exposure is NOT in the risk capture token set (gap to add).
weights.weightCitation: ESC/ERS 2022 Pulmonary Hypertension Guidelines (Humbert M et al., Eur Heart J 2022;43:3618-3731); Davidson's 24th ed
